plainSummary: Specs will show the same progress as their details, match the active count, and make recorded fixups easy to find.
summary: Independent review of added AC-5 through AC-7 and the user-confirmed discoverability amendment, using the refreshed related pack and existing owning workflow/progress contracts. Active is explicitly a lifecycle grouping, not agent liveness; Overview and URL-filtered list share its definition. Progress reuses existing completion observations with compact selected-view summaries, explicit refresh, isolated failures and honest historical/unknown states. Fixup links derive from recorded work type and exclude abandoned turns. The authorized prior turn metadata correction has explicit decision provenance while opened/facts/evidence/receipts remain unchanged. Eight declared screenshots retain prior progress coverage and add list/fixup views. Existing stronger trust, align and blocking policies are preserved. No blocking spec gaps found.
residualRisks: Tests should ensure All/Completed/Cancelled navigation and refresh cannot apply a stale response from a previously selected view, and one failed observation never removes unrelated rows.

Active defaults reduce normal observation work but do not bound an explicitly selected All view; keep summary computation bounded in concurrency and avoid sending full evidence payloads or polling every record.

Use deterministic recent ordering and owning-workstream joins for latest non-abandoned fixups; preserve distinct link targets for duplicate titles and explicit unknown correction text if records lack it.
Record the requested historical intent classification correction separately and verify original opened, facts, evidence and operation receipts remain byte-identical.
The related pack provides generic worktree caution text rather than actual sibling-path scan evidence.
